conflicts.fact: Estimated IQR for Subject 1 and Subject 2: Lessons 8 and 9 use the exact ungrouped IQRs (13.5 and 22.5) alongside graphs, while Lesson 7 and the fact sheet give the ogive estimates (13.2, 24.2). Lesson 8 labels Q1/Q3 as 73.5, 87 / 22, 44.5 while the ogives showed 73.8 / 46.2.
conflicts.versions: Lesson 7: IQR 13.2 and 24.2 (ogive estimates). Lessons 8 and 9: IQR 13.5 and 22.5 with no note that ogive estimates differ (13.2 and 24.2).

conflicts.fact: Range of classes in which Subject 1 scores cluster and where Subject 2 spreads (and the 'no score below 60' claim) are consistent, but Lesson 6 says Subject 1 is clustered 'between 60 and 99' while Lesson 3 says clustering is in 70-89 with none below 60; this is a wording difference rather than conflict.
conflicts.versions: Lesson 3: Subject 1 clusters in 70-89 (15 of 20). Lesson 6: scores clustered between 60 and 99.
